attacks.name: Poison Chain
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

abilities.name: Toxic Subjugation
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put 5 more damage counters on your opponent's Poisoned Pokémon during Pokémon Checkup.
